# telnyx_whatsapp_business_account_settings (Data Source)

The settings of a WhatsApp Business Account (WABA): its name, timezone and the webhooks that receive its WhatsApp events. Creating this resource adopts the settings of an existing WABA; destroying it leaves them as they are.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `whatsapp_business_account_id` (String) The whatsapp business account id.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Internal ID of Whatsapp business account
- `name` (String) Name of the WhatsApp Business Account.
- `record_type` (String)
- `timezone` (String) IANA timezone identifier
- `updated_at` (String)
- `webhook_enabled` (Boolean) Whether WhatsApp events are sent to the webhook URLs.
- `webhook_events` (Set of String) The WhatsApp events sent to the webhook URLs.
- `webhook_failover_url` (String) URL that receives the WhatsApp events of this account when webhook_url fails.
- `webhook_url` (String) URL that receives the WhatsApp events of this account.
